sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Lethargy for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Applies Domination Collapse (nullifies the target's buffs, reduces the target's critical hit chance to zero, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by the target by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases your character's max HP by 50% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 17000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 17000
